{{Quote|There are two things in this existence that will always be&mdash;the void between the stars and the munificent Galactic Republic.|Zovaren|<ref name="Rebellion Era Sourcebook">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Zovaren''' was a male [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] poet during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He and his people were freed from [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]].
